summary.text: Mimi Stewart is a Democrat who represents District 17 in Bernalillo County in the New Mexico Senate and is the Senate President Pro Tempore.
The legislature's member page lists Stewart as a representative from 1995 to 2014 and a senator since 2015, and as chair of the Senate Committees' Committee.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists Stewart's occupation as retired educator.
Stewart also sits on the Senate Judiciary Committee and the Senate Rules Committee and, between sessions, is co-chair of the Legislative Council and the Facilities Review Subcommittee.
